## Summary

Explain the problem, what changed and why. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. State any checks not run and any remaining live acceptance requirements. Offline legality or parsing is not a confirmed route win.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe affected versions, setup/recovery behavior, saved configuration, and any migration or rollback needs. For routes, list map/mode, prerequisites, provenance and separate victory/saved-medal evidence if available.

## Checklist

- [ ] This is focused on the stated problem; unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate offline regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant release notes are updated.
- [ ] No game/save files, original CHIMPS recordings, credentials, keys, user profiles or private bot code were changed or included.
- [ ] Attachments and logs are reviewed and redacted.
- [ ] Imported licenses, copyrights and route provenance are preserved.
- [ ] No owned medal was replayed solely for validation, and no healthy replay was interrupted to deploy this change.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the applicable project or third-party license.
